categories.main_business_segments: Nanjing Bestway Intelligent Control Technology Co., Ltd. primarily operates in the industrial internet sector, focusing on intelligent mining systems. Its main business includes the development and integration of smart mining information systems, covering software and hardware products such as intelligent mining control platforms, precise personnel positioning systems, intelligent auxiliary transportation monitoring, and safety monitoring systems. The company also extends its technology to non-coal mining and chemical industries, and is developing underground unmanned driving solutions.
categories.core_technologies_production_methods: The company leverages core technologies including industrial internet, IoT, digital twin, AI, 5G communication, and cloud computing. It integrates these technologies into comprehensive smart mining solutions with multi-layered architectures covering perception, network transmission, production execution, and platform application layers. Production methods combine in-house software development with hardware manufacturing and outsourced processing for non-core components, supported by an intelligent manufacturing workshop with automation equipment to enhance efficiency and quality.
categories.primary_customers_markets: The primary customers are large state-owned coal mining enterprises in China, with expanding markets in non-coal mining and chemical industries. The company serves industrial clients requiring intelligent mining solutions to improve safety, efficiency, and automation. Its products are widely used in underground coal mines, non-coal metal and non-metal mines, and hazardous chemical production facilities.
categories.geographic_coverage: The company mainly operates within China, with significant sales concentrated in the North China region, followed by East China, Northwest, Central China, Northeast, South China, and Southwest regions. It has established sales offices and service centers in key customer areas to provide localized support.
categories.supply_chain_position: Nanjing Bestway operates primarily in the midstream segment of the supply chain, focusing on the design, development, and integration of intelligent mining information systems. It develops proprietary software and hardware products and integrates third-party components to deliver comprehensive solutions to mining operators.
categories.strategic_focus_rd_direction: The company prioritizes R&D in intelligent mining technologies, including unmanned underground vehicles, 5G integrated dispatch communication systems, AI-based video analysis, high-precision positioning using UWB, and intelligent inspection robots. It maintains a strong focus on innovation, with significant investment in R&D personnel and projects to sustain technological leadership and expand into new industrial sectors.
categories.revenue_model: Revenue is primarily generated through the sale of smart mining system products, including software and hardware, as well as related technical services. The company employs a direct sales model supplemented by distributors, with revenues recognized upon delivery and acceptance of products or completion of services.
categories.key_competitors_industry_positioning: The company is a leading domestic provider in the intelligent mining industry, recognized among the top three IT companies in China's coal industry information technology sector. It holds a competitive advantage through its comprehensive product portfolio covering sensing, communication, control, and intelligent applications, supported by strong R&D capabilities and industry certifications.
categories.financial_scale_growth_profile: In 2024, the company reported operating revenue of approximately RMB 1.13 billion, representing a 12.05% increase year-over-year. Net profit attributable to shareholders was RMB 201.2 million, a decrease of 10.56% compared to the previous year. The company has shown steady revenue growth with a compound annual growth rate of 22.25% over recent years, supported by expanding market demand and continuous innovation.
categories.value_proposition_product_differentiatio: Nanjing Bestway emphasizes safety enhancement, labor reduction, efficiency improvement, and energy saving in mining operations through its intelligent mining systems. Its products integrate software and hardware with high system integration, compatibility, and stability. The company’s strong R&D capabilities, extensive certifications, and comprehensive service system provide customers with reliable, cutting-edge, and customized intelligent mining solutions that address complex underground mining environments.
